data.title: Ukraine’s former defense minister launches ‘Manhattan Project’ for killer robots
data.description: Mykhailo Fedorov told Defense News he wants humanoid-like robots on the battlefield within six months and an assault without infantry within a year.
data.author: Katie Livingstone
